messages:
alex.w: Customer reported repeated 504s when calling /v1/keys/attach against our on-prem HSM gateway. Happened after a scheduled key rotation window. They see long attach latency (~8-12s) then timeout.
maria.k: Ticket #C-48921. Customer says attach eventually succeeds on retry but app billing spikes for attach attempts.
jonah: Can you paste the curl we used and the gateway logs? Need header auth, X-Request-ID, and HSM response codes.
alex.w: Repro curl: 
```curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -X POST https://onprem-gw.example.com/v1/keys/attach -d '{"key_id":"km-12345","slot":"hsm-1"}'```
gateway log snippet: 
```
[2026-05-04T08:03:21Z] req=rtk-8a1f auth=ok start=0.001s
[2026-05-04T08:03:29Z] req=rtk-8a1f hsm_call=start host=hsm-1
[2026-05-04T08:03:37Z] req=rtk-8a1f hsm_call=timeout code=504 backend=cloudhsm-connector
[2026-05-04T08:03:37Z] req=rtk-8a1f retry=1
```
lina: HSM connector reports intermittent TCP retransmits and higher RTTs to the appliance during that window. Could be network flapping or HSM CPU saturation during keystore sync.
maria.k: Customer also called out missing audit entries for the attach attempts in their retention logs — last seen entry at 08:00 then gap until 08:10. Compliance team flagged this.
jonah: Two separate problems: 1) attach latency/timeouts; 2) audit log gap. We should treat as compliance escalation. @support-lead please advise SLA escalation path.
support-lead: Acknowledged. Opening enterprise compliance escalation and CC legal/security. Logging an immediate request for retention snapshot and index of audit events. Also requesting HSM onbox syslogs.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-20260504-742. Pager notified on-call infra.
jonah: Quick triage steps I ran: 1) ran tcpdump from gateway to hsm-1 during repro windows -> observed retransmits and 3-way handshake delays. 2) polled HSM metrics: queue_depth spike ~300 requests, CPU 95% for ~40s. 3) queried keystore-sync logs -> noted an automatic background rekey job starting 08:02.
alex.w: Customer says the rekey job was triggered by their ops teams trying to rotate keys. They rotated multiple keys concurrently.
lina: That explains queueing. Attach operations require exclusive token handle acquisition on the HSM which blocks while rekey runs. We should recommend serializing rotations or schedule low-traffic window.
maria.k: For the audit gap: looks like the on-prem audit forwarder crashed around 08:01 and restarted 08:07. Forwarder didn't persist buffer to disk in that build — bug. Missing lines were in ephemeral memory.
jonah: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) advise customer to pause concurrent bulk rotations and retry attaches. 2) provide temporary fallback: route attach requests to Redwood-hosted HSM-proxy (requires consent) to complete in-flight attaches. 3) provide audit extraction: if customer allows, we'll pull syslog snapshot and deliver a signed tarball for compliance.
support-lead: Do it. Please prepare the hosted-proxy runbook and the signed snapshot process. Legal needs an outline of data handling for the transfer.
alex.w: I pushed a small patch to audit-forwarder to persist in-memory buffer to disk on restart; will backport to current on-prem release and deliver hotfix. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/audit-forwarder/patches/234
lina: Ops note: when running hosted-proxy failover, expect billing to reflect cross-zone egress and proxy attach unit charges — warn the customer.
maria.k: I'll draft the customer communication: explanation, repro timeline, recommended actions, and offer of signed audit snapshot.
jonah: Follow-ups: assign remediation ticket to eng-runtime for HSM connector backpressure handling and to eng-ops for forwarder durability fix. I'll include packet captures and metrics dumps in the ticket.
support-lead: Thanks team. Targeting customer update within 2h. If any showstopper, escalate to CTO. :thumbsup:
